name: World Statistic
author: MickeyDisn
description: World Statistic — a live dig-site census tool. Count elements, terrains and structures on authorized cells, track history with graphs, home resource cards, dig % vs baseline, and optional auto-refresh. Select the tool to open the overlay; lock it to keep it open.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the tool and overlay are not registered; orphan cleanup still runs.

autoRefresh.label: Auto refresh
autoRefresh.description: After the world is ready, run a scan once and then on the interval below. Can also be toggled in the panel.

timeRange.label: Every N min
timeRange.description: Record one data point every N minutes when Auto refresh is on. Replaces the old 'autoRefreshMinutes' setting, whose value is still honoured.

maxCountSave.label: Max data points
maxCountSave.description: Max stored data points. When full the oldest point is dropped, so storage stays bounded.

historyMax.label: Display points
historyMax.description: How many data points to render on sparklines and charts (5–200).
